strict_protocols.production_replay: Current and Phase-only keep target-observation P38 exactly to describe current production behavior.
strict_protocols.scientific_controlled: Current/Phase-only frozen background P38 and Row-LS use paired C+N; target truth is evaluation-only.

adaptive_policy.steering: physical receive path difference plus clutter-ridge Doppler; corrected JDL uses a 12-D temporal/spatial steering vector
adaptive_policy.SA_MNEC: approximate academic reference; not a full paper reproduction

metrics.formal_suppression: residual_suppression_dB only; old CA_dB and CSR_dB duplicate formula was removed
metrics.fixed_region: all Doppler rows and configured rg_st..rg_ed range columns
metrics.target_detected: single-case GO-CFAR ROI indicator; never interpreted as a probability at row level
metrics.Pd: empirical Bernoulli detection probability aggregated across independent seeds/trials with Wilson 95% intervals
metrics.ROC: dedicated roc mode sweeps the GO-CFAR threshold scale over regenerated target/background cases
metrics.MDV: only reported from regenerated physical velocity sweep, never from RD np.roll

raw_data_policy: generated per-case BIN/config directories are removed after processing unless --keep-data is explicitly supplied

sanity.steering_definition: common-transmit receive path difference using configured four-channel phase centres, carrier phase sign, beam side and clutter Doppler ridge
